content: Name Dcm_OpStatusType Kind Type Derived from uint8 DCM_INITIAL 0x00 Indicates the initial call to the operation DCM_PENDING 0x01 Indicates that a pending return has been done on the previous call of the operation DCM_CANCEL 0x02 Indicates that the DCM requests to cancel the pending operation Range DCM_FORCE_RCRRP_OK 0x03 Confirm a response pending transmission Description  Variation  Available via Rte_Dcm_Type.h
